# ToolFront

> ToolFront is a free, open-source toolkit for AI-agent readiness: it scans any
> public website and reports how well AI agents can read, quote and operate it.
> Scan result is a 0–100 score with six checks and a prioritised fix list.

## What the scan checks

- **WebMCP tools** (20 pts) — whether the site exposes callable tools so agents
  can complete tasks (search, add-to-cart, booking) instead of screenshot-and-click.
- **Tool surface security** (10 pts) — tool names, descriptions and parameters
  audited against prompt-injection and tool-poisoning patterns.
- **Structured data** (20 pts) — JSON-LD / schema.org coverage, so prices,
  ratings and product facts can be quoted accurately instead of guessed.
- **llms.txt** (15 pts) — one markdown file that tells agents what the site does
  in the site's own words.
- **AI crawler policy** (10 pts) — robots.txt guidance naming AI agents, so the
  site states a policy instead of relying on defaults.
- **Machine-readable surfaces** (25 pts) — sitemap.xml and OpenAPI, the map
  agents use instead of crawling page by page.

## How to use ToolFront

- Scan any domain: `https://toolfront.dev/report?domain=example.com`
- Results are returned as a graded report (A–F) with per-check status
  (pass / partial / fail / not-verifiable), business-impact notes and a fix list
  sorted by points gained.
- No account or API key is required for public sites.

## Our scanner's identity

- User-agent: `ToolFront-Scanner/0.3`
- It reads five paths only: `/`, `/robots.txt`, `/llms.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`,
  `/openapi.json`. It does not execute JavaScript and does not authenticate.
- Site owners can exclude it with a robots.txt rule, and can read exactly what
  it does and why at `https://toolfront.dev/bot`.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://toolfront.dev/) — what ToolFront does and how to start a scan
- [Example report](https://toolfront.dev/report?domain=vercel.com) — a live
  agent-readiness report for a real site
- [Scanner declaration](https://toolfront.dev/bot) — what our crawler reads, and
  how to opt out
- [Privacy policy](https://toolfront.dev/privacy) — what we store and for how long
- [Security](https://toolfront.dev/security) — how the service is built and hardened
- [Terms](https://toolfront.dev/terms) — terms of use
